sections.title: About this guide
data: This guide covers three small-boat stations on the Maine coast east of Acadia, each with its own Coast Guard homes: Southwest Harbor, Jonesport and Eastport. The home counts come from the Coast Guard's housing map (updated 10/30/2026).
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 20 active homes at Southwest Harbor, 14 active homes at Jonesport and 7 active homes at Eastport.

At Jonesport the Coast Guard finished a 12-unit family housing development in 2021 for Station Jonesport and the cutter Moray, and sold its older housing there at auction in 2025 (Coast Guard SHORE Spotlight, August 2025).

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
